objective: Test whether identity-paired high-visibility supervision improves 10 dB ISRJ separability rather than only response magnitude

identity.rule: all power views of one identity remain in the same train, early-stop, or development role

views.inference_inputs: 10 dB I/Q-derived frozen physical features and frozen B2-RC ISRJ probability only

model.type: bounded residual MLP over frozen shared physical features
model.teacher_confidence_rule: teacher probability is at least the frozen B2-Hard ISRJ threshold
model.checkpoint_selection: 10 dB early-stop ISRJ AUPR, then hard-negative FPR; development is not used

threshold_rule: reuse frozen B2-RC thresholds; no per-variant or per-power threshold tuning

decision.pass: enter B8 composition-disjoint generalization without changing B7 architecture or thresholds
decision.fail: stop route B at frozen B2-RC/B3-R and do not construct B8 deep reliability experts

forbidden: forcing all powers to share identical representations in the primary method
using explicit JNR in the deployable primary method
